layers.name: Domain
layers.purpose: Domain holds the booking and rate model and the ports the web tier depends on.

layers.name: Web
layers.purpose: Web is the HTTP surface of the monolith: the controllers, their request and response models, and the data access behind them.

rules.sentence: The Domain layer must not reference the Web layer.
rules.because: Domain holds the booking and rate model the rest of the system depends on; it must not reach up into the web tier.
rules.fix: Define the abstraction in Meridian.Domain and implement it in Meridian.Web.

rules.sentence: Types derived from `ControllerBase` must be named `*Controller`.
rules.because: Request handlers are found by their `*Controller` name — by routing and by agents reading the code; keep the convention total.

rules.sentence: Types in `Meridian.Web.Controllers.*` must not reference `SqlConnection` or `SqlCommand`.
rules.because: Data access behind a repository can be tested and swapped; SQL in the request path cannot.
rules.fix: Move the SQL into a repository.

migrate.from: Controllers open SqlConnection and run inline SQL directly.
migrate.toSentence: Types in `Meridian.Web.Controllers.*` must not reference `SqlConnection` or `SqlCommand`.

rules.sentence: Types in the Web layer, except types named `SystemClock`, must not use `DateTime.Now` or `DateTime.UtcNow`.
rules.because: Cutoffs, demurrage, and ETA stamps read from the wall clock cannot be tested at a fixed instant; an injected IClock makes the moment an input.

migrate.from: Code reads the ambient clock directly.
migrate.toSentence: Types in the Web layer, except types named `SystemClock`, must not use `DateTime.Now` or `DateTime.UtcNow`.

rules.sentence: Methods returning `Task`, `Task<TResult>`, `ValueTask` or `ValueTask<TResult>` declared in authored types in the Domain or Web layers must be named `*Async`.
rules.because: Task- and ValueTask-returning methods carry the Async suffix so callers see at the call site that a method must be awaited.
rules.fix: Rename the method to end in Async and update its callers; see the interface and its implementation together.

migrate.from: Repository and controller methods return Task without the Async suffix.
migrate.toSentence: Methods returning `Task`, `Task<TResult>`, `ValueTask` or `ValueTask<TResult>` declared in authored types in the Domain or Web layers must be named `*Async`.

rules.because: Calling BuildServiceProvider while configuring services builds a second container with its own singletons, a duplicate-instance trap.
rules.fix: Register the dependency and let the host build the provider once; inject what you need.

rules.sentence: Types in `Meridian.Clearance.*`, except `IClearanceGateway` or `ClearanceGateway`, must be referenced only by types in `Meridian.Clearance.*`, `IClearanceGateway` or `ClearanceGateway`.
rules.because: The check-digit table implements a published external standard with no cleaner target shape; contain it behind the gateway rather than change it.

scope.dragons: ISO 6346 check digit: the letter-value table skips every multiple of 11 (A=10, B=12 … U=32); the gaps are structural — linearizing the table breaks every real container number. Call in only through IClearanceGateway.
